history.content: Hi, this is AI Jane from Northside Physio, I'm just calling to remind you about your appointment tomorrow with Sarah at 9:30 AM — is this Sam?
Is there anything you'd like to know before you come in tomorrow?
Actually I can't make it tomorrow.

history.name: smart_voice_agent
history.content: {"success": true, "found_appointment_id": "1234567890123456789", "message": "I found your Thursday the 15th appointment at 9:30 AM with Sarah. Is that the one you'd like to cancel?", "agent_instruction": "AGENT INSTRUCTION, for the caller's next reply only (a newer tool call or result replaces it). Say the message field aloud now, exactly as written: that is your whole reply this turn, with no tool call. Then, on the caller's reply: (1) yes: say \"Checking that now, one moment.\" and call smart_voice_agent with intent=cancel and appointment_id=1234567890123456789; a yes that comes with another request (\"and ring me back\") is still a yes, so cancel first and handle the request afterwards. (2) a yes that also asks a question (\"yeah, what name is it under?\") is not a yes yet: say \"I can only see the day, time and practitioner on my end.\" then ask \"Should I go ahead and cancel that one?\". (3) no, or that it is the wrong one: say \"No problem.\" and call universal_router wrap_up in the same response, nothing else. (4) anything else, such as a new request or a complaint: the caller has not confirmed, so this is not a cancel; deal with what they raised first, by the rules for it."}

history.content: {"success": true, "cancelled": true, "appointment_id": "1234567890123456789", "reschedule_offer_pending": "true", "message": "Your appointment on Thursday the 15th at 9:30 AM with Sarah has been cancelled.", "agent_instruction": "AGENT INSTRUCTION: the cancel call in this history has already succeeded, so never call smart_voice_agent cancel again.
